name: Death Legions
worldbuilding: Organized undead kingdoms, ancient tomb empires, necromantic city-states, and endless armies of skeletons and corpses. Their forces win through persistence, attrition, and the replacement of casualties. Both signature Core choices are Infantry, leaving conventional undead archers and mounted warriors to generic profiles.

factionRule.name: Endless Dead
factionRule.effect: The first time each Round an Undead Unit with more than one starting Model survives an Attack that defeats one or more of its basic Models, roll 1D6 for each Model defeated by that Attack. For each 6+, restore one defeated basic Model to that surviving Unit, up to its starting size, placing returned Models legally in Coherency. This passive effect may return Models while Engaged but cannot restore a completely destroyed Unit.

factionCommands.name: Rise Again
factionCommands.effect: Either restore one defeated basic Model to a surviving, unengaged friendly Undead Unit (up to starting size), or once per battle, return one completely destroyed friendly Undead Core Unit with two original basic Models in legal Coherency, wholly within the friendly Deployment Zone at the end of Movement. That returned Unit cannot activate, Charge, or control objectives this Round. Both uses retain normal CP/card requirements.

factionCommands.name: Death March
factionCommands.effect: The active eligible Undead Unit may immediately make an additional normal Move, ending legally. It cannot make a ranged Attack this Round; this does not refresh its Movement activation or remove Withdrawn.

factionCommands.name: The Dead Do Not Tire
factionCommands.effect: Remove one negative condition from the active friendly Undead Unit.

factionCommands.name: Sever the Vanguard
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Elite 4 or Anti-Cavalry 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

abilities.name: Mass of Dead
abilities.effect: Gain Accurate 2 while this unit still has more than half its starting models.

abilities.name: Deathless Discipline
abilities.effect: Ignore the first Slow effect applied each Round.

abilities.name: Ranks of the Dead
abilities.effect: Gain Accurate 1 while at least 4 Models remain.

abilities.name: Dread Volley
abilities.effect: When declaring a Bone Bows Attack, spend 1 CP. If that Attack inflicts at least one unsaved Damage on its target, the target gains Slow 1 for its next Move. This affects the target Unit once, regardless of Models or the number of Hits. This does not grant an additional Attack.

abilities.name: Relentless Formation
abilities.effect: One friendly Undead Infantry Unit within Short ignores Slow and Difficult Terrain movement penalties during its next Move.

captainAndSpecialists.name: Necromancer-Lord

abilities.name: Raise Dead
abilities.effect: Return up to two defeated basic Models to one surviving, unengaged friendly Undead Core Unit within Short, up to its starting size. Cannot restore a completely destroyed Unit.

captainAndSpecialists.note: The Necromancer-Lord and Ossuary Keeper could have different Mortal or Undead traits depending on their lore.
tagChoiceNotes: Default Mortal; alternate creature identity requires an explicitly selected Unit conversion or scenario permission. Faction alone does not assign creature type.

captainAndSpecialists.name: Ossuary Keeper

abilities.name: Rebind Bones
abilities.effect: One friendly Undead Unit within Short that has lost a Model this Round gains Tough 2 until the end of the Round.

captainAndSpecialists.note: The Necromancer-Lord and Ossuary Keeper could have different Mortal or Undead traits depending on their lore.
tagChoiceNotes: Default Undead; alternate creature identity requires an explicitly selected Unit conversion or scenario permission. Faction alone does not assign creature type.

abilities.name: Reassembled
abilities.effect: The first time this Unit would be defeated, roll a D6. On 4+, remain at 1 Wound instead.

abilities.name: Necrotic Conduit
abilities.effect: Once per Round, after a nearby friendly Undead Unit returns a basic Model, Heal 1 Damage from that Unit if it has a wounded Model.

abilities.name: The King's Will
abilities.effect: Friendly Undead Units within Short ignore one negative condition caused by enemy auras.

abilities.name: Unbroken Legion
abilities.effect: After objectives are scored, return one defeated basic Model to each of up to four surviving, unengaged friendly Undead Units within Medium, up to their starting sizes.

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Basic spear Infantry, skeleton archers, conventional undead Cavalry, and ordinary Support specialists. The signature units emphasize massed corpses or elite tomb guardians, not every undead battlefield role.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: added Bone Archers as the faction's Extra Core, a Ranged Undead unit reinforcing attritional numbers rather than patching a weakness. Corpse Horde's weapon profile was kept unchanged (Models, not Attacks, is this faction's established horde-buff pattern). Other Damage-1 weapons gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Elite on the Bone Colossus' Colossal Blade, Anti-Monster on the Deathless King's Sepulchral Greatblade) or an improved Hit (Deathly Gaze 4+ -> 3+).
